feature: Brazil 2026 PNI — maternal VVSR routine rule
source_title: Instrução Normativa do Calendário Nacional de Vacinação 2026
fail_closed_boundaries: Do not treat a dose from a previous pregnancy as satisfying the current pregnancy.
Do not treat unknown or partial vaccination history as documented zero-dose history.
Do not repeat an already documented VVSR dose in the current pregnancy solely because it was administered before week 28.
Do not invent a maternal-age restriction.
Do not fabricate an exact future administration date from integer-only gestational-week input.

dtpa_deferred.reason: The 2026 national dTpa rule requires interval assessment across vaccines containing diphtheria and tetanus toxoids; vaccine-key-only history is insufficient for safe automation.
